content_html:
watched #Housefull4 : LOVED IT!!!!!! a perfect movie for you…if u want to enjoy a fun filled crazy movie without any logic!!!! but if u are a person who expects logic emotions and mesaage then please be at home….

I have been following all the Golmal and Housefull series and though this is not the best but it is not the worst……

Akshay Kumar is the real allrounder of Bollywood where he can fit into the super Action/National Integrity/Message Oriented and now into the madness of the Housefull so effortlessly and man he steals the show with his epic facial expressions and it really takes a lot to accept a char which is just a main comedian role and not a hero of the movie!!!!!

Being a big fan of Aakhri Pasta I was dissapointed that this char was not etched properly unlike the previous housefull series…..barring that dissapointment one can expect a lot many mad suprises like Nawazuddin doing an ITEM SONG and The Hulk Rana playing kawaalli singer Rangeela Raja _/\_

overall a nice time pass and laugh riot movie if you dont mind the illogical plot and mad comedy!!!!!
